scope: Independent review of the shared execution scheduler, exact original signed-case dispatch, and one separately reviewed ZERO continuation. No new physical or numerical admission.

findings.defect: The process-group scan accepts new groups only after the worker registers active[]. Popen in either worker creates a scientific group before active[] registration; the next dispatch iteration may observe this legitimate reserved launch and raise UNACCOUNTED_SCIENTIFIC_PROCESS_GROUP, losing its supervisor. Pending slot reservation bounds occupancy but does not prevent this false classification.
findings.authorized_minimal_repair: Synchronize the launch acknowledgement before any subsequent unknown-group scan, or recognize only the exact reserved immutable argv/output while registration is pending. Retain immediate slot reservation, exact group/source identity, and max2. Do not change original frozen launchers or numerical code.

findings.defect: Clean completion returns zero after persisting status OBSERVING, so the durable receipt does not identify supervisor completion.
findings.authorized_minimal_repair: Compute completion from empty queue/futures, segment dispatched, no adopted occupied process, and no blocked condition; persist a distinct completed execution status before return. Do not label full-history science complete.
